products.name: LedgerMedic
products.blurb: Finds and fixes costly QuickBooks Online errors, such as stuck Undeposited Funds and customer payments counted twice.
products.description: For small businesses, and the accountants who look after their QuickBooks Online books. Four mistakes quietly throw the books off: payments stuck in Undeposited Funds, Unapplied Cash Payment Income, deposits that count a payment twice, and credit card payments entered twice. LedgerMedic finds all four, explains each one in plain English, and fixes the first three at the source transaction after you preview the change.
highlights: Scans every QuickBooks Online company on your Intuit account
Read-only until you approve a fix, and every fix is previewed first

products.name: Sprinklerly
products.blurb: Operations software for irrigation and sprinkler contractors: scheduling, dispatch, routes, work orders and backflow compliance.
products.description: For irrigation and sprinkler contractors who are running the business on paper routes, group texts and spreadsheets. Sprinklerly puts customers, service-area booking, route planning, dispatch, work orders and backflow-test compliance in one place built for the trade, so nothing falls through the cracks between the office and the truck.
highlights: Customers book into open arrival windows on the service days you plan
Route planning with real drive times between stops
Backflow tests and technician certifications tracked with the paperwork trail

products.name: GrantClose
products.blurb: Post-award grant tracking for small nonprofits: every reporting deadline with an owner, the evidence beside it, and a closeout packet at the end.
products.description: For the executive director, development lead or program manager at a small nonprofit holding restricted grants. The reporting schedule usually lives in a PDF in someone's inbox. GrantClose reads the award letter, lets you confirm the schedule it contains, gives every deadline an owner with the evidence beside it, and exports a closeout packet when the award ends.
highlights: Finds the reports and dates in an award letter and shows the sentence each came from
Email reminders at 30, 14, 7, 1 and 0 days before each due date
Free for one active award, with every feature included

products.name: GigDriverProfit
products.blurb: Shows Android gig-delivery drivers the true profit per hour of each offer the moment it arrives.
products.description: For gig-delivery drivers on Android who want to know whether an offer is worth taking before they accept it. GigDriverProfit reads the offer notification the moment it lands, scores it by real net profit per hour after gas and wear, and hands you back to the platform's own app to decide.
highlights: Profit per hour counts fuel, wear and deadhead driving
Read-only: never asks for a platform login and never taps anything for you
Free plan available on Google Play

products.name: SPCC Plan Builder
products.blurb: Tells small facilities whether the EPA's SPCC rule applies to them, then builds a self-certified Tier I plan with review reminders.
products.description: For owners of small sites that store oil above ground. The federal SPCC rule (40 CFR Part 112) requires a written spill plan at many of them, and small facilities can often write and sign their own. SPCC Plan Builder works out whether the rule applies and whether you can self-certify as Tier I, assembles the plan from your answers, and reminds you when it is due for review.
highlights: A plain applicability verdict with the federal citation beside every answer
Secondary containment math with the working shown
Free to build and review on screen; you pay only for the clean export

products.name: Condo Records Portal
products.blurb: An official-records portal for Florida condo associations, with the posting checklist and request deadlines the statute requires.
products.description: For Florida condominium boards managing 25 or more units, which since January 1, 2026 must post their official records on a website or app. Condo Records Portal gives owners the login-protected records section the statute describes, and keeps the 30-day posting clock and the 10-working-day records-request clock in one place.
highlights: A posting board for every record listed in Fla. Stat. 718.111(12)(g)2
A request desk that counts working days and sends reminders
Flags protected information, such as Social Security numbers, in uploads so you can redact before posting
